params.caption: 🎮 Baldur's Gate 3 adds a new batch of approved console mods Players on Xbox and PlayStation can now try 14 newly approved mods in Baldur's Gate 3. The new wave widens the modding options available to console players, who only get mods that pass approval. 🕒 Nov 11, 2026 · 01:04 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: VGC #BaldursGate3 #Mods #GamingNews
